name: HighWay
definition: HighWay is BlackRoad's infrastructure, compute, routing, cloud, fleet, hosting, and observability product. HighWay is the road system under the road system. It handles the technical routes: servers, local nodes, cloud nodes, domains, tunnels, edge routes, GPUs, CPUs, Pi clusters, model servers, workers, queues, health checks, logs, and deployment surfaces. HighWay exists because modern infrastructure is overwhelming: Docker, Kubernetes, SSH keys, domains, SSL, cloud roles, environment variables, deployment scripts, queues, logs, model serving, GPUs, and local hardware. HighWay should make infrastructure understandable and routable.
core_promise: See the roads your system runs on.
